source: https://harvestportfolios.com/wp-content/uploads/hhis/pdf/fund-facts/en/hhis_ff.pdf — Harvest's own regulatory ETF Facts document for HHIS Class A Units, dated May 27, 2026 (MER as of Dec 31, 2025; sector mix as of Apr 30, 2026).
note: HHIS holds a basket of ~20 Harvest single-stock "Enhanced High Income" ETFs (Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, NVIDIA, etc.), all referencing individual US-listed companies. Yahoo Finance only returns one of these ~20 holdings, so the app's usual holdings-based geography estimate is derived from under 10% of the actual portfolio. This is the issuer's own published country/sector breakdown instead.
expenseRatioNote: Yahoo Finance reports no expense ratio for HHIS.TO. This is Harvest's own published Management Expense Ratio (MER) from its ETF Facts document — the fund itself charges a 0% management fee, but is subject to the fees of its underlying single-stock ETFs, which this MER reflects.
